newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian Jan-March budget deficit widens.
newsitem.headline: Belgian Jan-March budget deficit widens.

text.p: The Belgian federal state's net borrowing requirement widened to 96.9 billion francs in March from 79.5 billion in the year-ago month, the finance and budget ministries said in a statement on Thursday.
The cumulative borrowing requirement for the first three months of 1997 widened to 243.1 billion francs from 217.1 billion in the same period last year.

The ministries said the wider deficit in the first quarter was due principally to larger than expected transfers of some 20 billion francs to regional and local authorities. Belgium's contribution to the European Union budget also rose by seven billion francs in the first quarter, the statement said.
